design_system.estilo: Microsoft Fluent 2, corporate, clean, high information density, line icons

moldura.header: 100 px top bar in the primary color: app name and screen title on the left; unit selector, user name and date and time on the right; white text
moldura.navegacao: left side menu in dark primary, 260 px, icon + label per item, active item in primary, collapse button
moldura.notificacoes: toast in the top-right corner, dark background, icon and left border in the status color (green success, yellow warning, red error), time bar at the bottom
moldura.popups: modal centered over a background darkened to 50%, white card with radius 12: title, text, primary button on the right and gray secondary button on the left
moldura.carregando: semi-transparent overlay over the screen with a spinner and the message of the action in progress
moldura.estados: empty list with an icon and a sentence saying what to do; 'no access' panel with a padlock and the owner's contact
moldura.rodape: discreet line 'Showing N of M records' below the gallery

telas.objetivo: follow the unit's orders and act on one of them
telas.descricao: four KPI cards (open, in progress, closed, total); filter bar with status, search by number and period; gallery in table format with number, unit, status as a colored pill, creation date and one action button per row

telas.estado: confirmation modal open over the list
telas.descricao: the same list in the background, darkened; modal 'Close order 000123?' with the order summary and the buttons Cancel and Close
the updated list, order 000123 now with closed status; green toast 'Order closed.' in the top-right corner

telas.estado: form being filled in, one field with a validation error
telas.descricao: wide form modal over the list: unit (fixed AAA), type, description and expected date; the description field with a red border and the message 'Enter the description'; buttons Cancel and Save

telas.objetivo: see the unit overview and go straight to the most common action
telas.descricao: four unit KPI cards (total, open, in progress, closed); shortcut row with the buttons New order and View orders; compact table with the 5 most recent orders: protocol, requester, status as a colored pill and change date

telas.perfil: user without a role in the app
telas.descricao: normal header without the menu; in the center, a panel with a padlock, the text 'You do not have access to this app yet' and the contact support@contoso.com
